incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired: latency-slo-p95 (service=inference-api, region=us-west1) — threshold=400ms, current=720ms. Pager: pd-inc-8675309. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/pd-inc-8675309
PagerDuty: Incident pd-inc-8675309 triggered by monitor latency-slo-p95. Acknowledge to start.
Alex G: acked on PagerDuty, jumping in. Any known deploys?
Devon L: no deploys in the last 20m from CI. I see CPU steal on nodes in us-west1-autoscale-pool.
Priya S: seeing p95 jump across both sidecar and hotpath, p99 at ~1.8s. Some timeouts logged.
Maria R: customers on us-west region might be affected, flagging customer-impact review.
Alex G: rolling through runbook steps. First: confirm affected tiers and isolate hotpath. Devon, can you post the top 3 noisy routes?
Devon L: noisy routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat_stream, /v1/embeddings. 80% of traffic is /v1/generate.
Priya S: metrics: request_rate steady, but tail latency spike correlates with KV cache evictions. evictions/sec jumped ~x8 at 12:41 UTC.
Alex G: ok, possible KV-cache thrash. Is autoscaler making lots of scale-downs/ups?
sre-bot: autoscaler events (summary): scale_up 12:35 -> +4 pods, scale_down 12:38 -> -3 pods, scale_up 12:40 -> +3 pods. Rapid oscillation detected.
Devon L: looks like rapid oscillation leading to cold starts for models. Cold tokenizers at 12:41 show warmup latency spikes.
Maria R: customer impact: support reported 6 customer sessions with 5xxs in last 10m, highest for premium org "AcmeRetail". Not yet widespread but could be bad if continues.
Alex G: mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler for inference pool, 2) increase min replicas to avoid scale-to-zero, 3) enable degraded fallback model (quantized variant) for low-priority traffic, 4) warm KV-cache. Devon, Priya, take steps 1/2. I'll drive 3/4.
Devon L: running command to patch HPA now...
Devon L: ```bash
kubectl patch hpa inference-hotpath -n inference --patch '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'
```
Devon L: patched minReplicas=6; also paused autoscaler (scaleDown disabled) via infra-api.
Priya S: confirming nodes: bringing up 3 spare nodes in us-west1-autoscale-pool; cloud scale request submitted. Estimated ready ~2m.
Alex G: enabling fallback model route. Will route non-SLA and low-priority keys to quant-variant. Doing a canary 10% first.
Alex G: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"gptx-compact-q4","traffic_split":{"primary":90,"fallback":10}}
```
Maria R: notified support and CSMs: initial message to AcmeRetail sent — informing they may see increased latency and advising retry/backoff.
Priya S: KV-cache warming script running now, warming prefixes for top 50 keys. logs show warming requests hitting sidecars successfully.
Devon L: sidecar logs: a handful of timeouts 12:42:15-12:42:55, then reduced after warming starts.
Alex G: p95 now down to 420ms (was 720ms). p99 1.2s. Still above target but improving.
incident-bot: note: pagerduty escalation scheduled in 8m if not acknowledged by higher tier.
Maria R: handoff plan: I'll stay on until p95 < 350ms for 10m window, then hand to oncall rotation. Alex, can you log the mitigation actions in the incident tracker?
Alex G: logging now in tracker: incident-pd-8675309. Actions: paused autoscaler, minReplicas=6, added spare nodes, canary fallback model 10%, warmed KV cache, notified AcmeRetail.
Priya S: evidence: graphs attached to ticket (link internal metrics). Warmth seems to hold; evictions/sec trending down.
Devon L: observing one noisy client sending large bursts every 30s from IP 34.120.66.12 — throttling that IP at edge for now.
Alex G: applied rate-limit rule to edge: 34.120.66.12 -> 10req/s. Request patterns look less spiky.
Maria R: customer update sent: "we're mitigating a tail latency issue; we've applied fallbacks and scaling; we'll update in 30m or earlier." :thumbsup:
Priya S: p95 360ms now, p99 820ms. We'll keep monitoring.
Alex G: preparing handoff notes: root cause likely autoscaler hysteresis + KV-cache thrash causing model coldstarts and tokenization warmup cost. Immediate mitigation: pause scaler, raise min replicas, warm cache, fallback model. Long term: tune autoscaler cooldown and add pre-warm for tokenizer.
Maria R: accepting handoff at 12:52 UTC. I'll remain primary contact and update incident on-call.
Alex G: handing off to Maria R for continued monitoring / customer comms. Good job team.
Maria R: will continue until we have stable 10m window p95 < 350ms. If p99 stays >1s we'll escalate to platform team.
Devon L: creating follow-up ticket for autoscaler cooldown tuning and hotspot protection.
incident-bot: incident pd-inc-8675309 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). Next: postmortem required if incident > 30m or customer-impact confirmed.
Priya S: adding note: AcmeRetail saw 4 failed requests, support ticket #INC-4512.
Alex G: thumbs up. I'll do a quick retrospective doc after stable and include KG graph links.
Maria R: thanks. dropping in 15m unless regression. :white_check_mark:
